description.value:
Prerequisite: High-Notum Anomaly, Eldritch, or Psychic Homeworld

Exposure to planetary Notum resonance or psionic fauna has expanded your neural conduits.

  • Psychic Shielding: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.
  • Mental Bastion: You have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened conditions.

system.requirements: High-Notum Anomaly, Eldritch, or Psychic Homeworld
